pre_results_analysis: Stratified SRSWOR paired variance with finite corrections. Supplement normal intervals with simultaneous exact hypergeometric directional-transition bounds; conservative interval governs practical-margin classifications.
pre_results_amendment: Before any generation requests or comparative outcome inspection, an all-zero synthetic transition check showed the 400-record design could not meet the ±5pp criterion (CI ±5.9846pp). Increase to 600 (300/domain; sample sizes 110/190/59/241) with the same seeded ordering and 40-repo pilot/repeat; synthetic all-zero CI becomes ±2.4779pp. Subsequently, still before any generation requests, GPT-4o was selected for both stages. Sample, prompts, intervention and decision margins remain unchanged; the archived-versus-fresh comparison is now a cross-configuration diagnostic. Pre-amendment configuration and implementation are archived in history/20260919-v2-mini-before-gpt4o.
